description: This file defines a PHP trait named TimesheetServiceTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Time\Traits\Service. The trait provides a protected method getTimesheetService() that returns an instance of the TimesheetService, retrieved via a service container. It includes use statements for external traits and services, and serves as a reusable component for handling timesheet-related services in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getTimesheetService
methods.description: Returns an instance of TimesheetService from the service container.
